One proposal per pull request.

- [ ] I read every source myself, on the day given in the file.
- [ ] It was not made as paid work for anyone, and not under a promise to keep it confidential (`--not-paid-work`).
- [ ] I give it under the contributor terms in CONTRIBUTING.md (CC0 1.0 for a proposal, AGPL-3.0 for anything else).
- [ ] `node tools/check.mjs` ends with "everything stands".

Reviewers: read the sources, then say whether the claim holds, holds in part (which part), or does not, and why.
